newsitem.title: INDIA: Honda to raise stake in Indian venture.
newsitem.headline: Honda to raise stake in Indian venture.

text.p: India has authorised Honda Motor Co Ltd to temporarily raise its stake in a joint venture with India's Shriram Industrial Enterprises Ltd (SIEL).
The government said in a statement that the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment authorised the Japanese partner to raise its stake in Honda Siel Cars India Ltd to 90 percent from 60 percent.
Honda's 60 percent stake amounting to 1.08 billion rupees would be raised to 90 percent worth 1.62 billion, it said.
It said that SIEL, due to a cash flow contraint, was not currently in a position to contribute its full share of 40 percent of the paid-up equity capital of 1.8 billion rupees by March 31, 1997.
However, it pledged to raise its share to 40 percent by August 31, 1998.

"This approval is subject to the condition that by August 31, 1998, the Indian partner should buy back a 30 percent additional foreign equity holding or the additional foreign equity holding should...be diluted," the government statement said.
